note: verify:holo thresholds. Re-measured at H2-0 start on main 3d8a1ce; update after every merged PR (counts only grow). scripts/verify/verify-holo.mjs reads every threshold from here.

osHandoff.note: 1x run only (default). DEVIATED must be <= floor(baselineDeviated x 1.5) = 16, else INVALID. baselineDeviated: 11 measured 2026-11-15 on the machine in measuredOn (102 samples, 91 conclusive; earlier runs 11-12).

perf.note: hp1MinFps5k / hp1MinFps20k are the spec HP1 hard minimums (FAIL below). hp1WarnFps20k is a regression tripwire: the 20k run measured about 56 fps, so below 45 (still above the 30 minimum) is INVALID and goes to L2.

measuredOn.machine: AMD Ryzen 7 PRO 8840HS / AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (real GPU, headed Chrome), 28 GB RAM
measuredOn.note: os-handoff DEVIATED baseline and the perf numbers are machine-specific; re-measure and justify in the PR body when the machine changes

osHandoff4x.note: 4x gives very few conclusive passes, so it is only good for catching FAIL; the main evidence for the input gate comes from the 1x run. Thresholds come from three full 4x runs on main 3d8a1ce (same code as c8bc1b9), 2026-11-16/17, all 102 samples, taking the worst: run 1 (L2) 23 conclusive / 79 DEVIATED / 0 FAIL; run 2 37 / 64 / 1 FAIL (sample "I2 switch/first-click/hash x4 planned=0", timeout waiting for phase switching-post); run 3 24 / 78 / 0 FAIL. Worst conclusive 23 -> conclusiveMin 20; worst DEVIATED 79 -> deviatedMax 90 (an explicit number: x1.5 would exceed the sample count 102). An earlier measurement on the branch also had 2 I2 phase-timeout FAILs (exiting-post, switching-post). The I2 phase timeout is a known-on-main flake: see knownOnMain.

knownOnMain.notePattern: ^error: eval failed: Error: timeout waiting for phase [\w-]+-post \(have [\w-]+-pre>[^)]*\)$
knownOnMain.source: main 3d8a1ce, full 4x run 2 (2026-11-16): sample "I2 switch/first-click/hash x4 planned=0", note "error: eval failed: Error: timeout waiting for phase switching-post (have switching-pre>station)"; a first measurement the same day had the same shape on "I2 exit/first-click" (exiting-post)
